title: Free 12-month Times Prime membership with HDFC Millennia card
body: HDFC Millennia cardholders can activate a complimentary one-year Times Prime membership worth Rs 1199 via the SmartBuy portal until 31 March. Existing cardholders only, two-minute activation.

title: Amazon Prime members: free Grubhub-style Swiggy One Lite for 6 months
body: Prime members get 6 months of Swiggy One Lite (worth Rs 599) bundled free. Activate from the Prime benefits page, no payment details needed.

title: Google One 100GB free for 12 months for existing Google accounts
body: Promotional entitlement: 100GB Google One for a year, value Rs 1300, one-click activation for accounts in India. No card required, no auto-renew.

title: Flipkart SuperCoins: redeem 0 coins for 3-month Zee5 subscription today only
body: Zero-coin redemption event: 3 months of Zee5 Premium (worth Rs 599) free for all SuperCoin users in India. Redeem in the app, ends tonight 23:59 IST.

title: GitHub Student-style promo: JetBrains All Products Pack free 1 year for open-source maintainers
body: Maintainers of any active open-source repo get a free 1-year JetBrains All Products Pack license (worth Rs 20000). Apply with your existing GitHub account, approval within days.

title: Free Rs 500 Amazon voucher for existing ICICI iMobile users, 1 tap
body: ICICI Bank app users: claim a Rs 500 Amazon Pay voucher from the rewards tab. Existing users only, instant credit, India.

title: Spotify Premium 3 months free for current free-tier users, no card
body: Spotify India: free-tier accounts get 3 months of Premium (worth Rs 357) with genuinely no payment method required and no auto-renewal.

title: Decathlon members: free branded steel bottle worth Rs 699 with any visit
body: Walk into any Decathlon store, show your existing member QR, take a free 750ml steel bottle. No purchase necessary, till stocks last, all India stores.

title: Airtel Thanks: free Disney+ Hotstar Mobile 12 months on existing plans
body: Airtel postpaid users on Rs 399+ plans already have a bundled Hotstar Mobile entitlement worth Rs 899 — activation takes one tap in the Thanks app.

title: Free Anthropic API credits Rs 4000 for personal projects, existing accounts
body: Developers with an existing account get $50 in API credits free, no card needed, applies automatically after opting in. Worldwide including India.

title: FREE enterprise architecture t-shirt for webinar attendees!
body: Register for our 90-minute digital transformation webinar with your business email and verified attendees receive an exclusive branded t-shirt. Qualified IT decision makers only.

title: Get a FREE Rs 100 voucher when you spend Rs 2000 at MegaMart
body: This week only: purchase Rs 2000 or more of groceries and receive a Rs 100 discount voucher for your next visit.

title: Free iPhone 15! Just complete 5 surveys and refer 10 friends
body: Earn points by completing partner surveys and referring friends. Top referrers qualify for a chance at a free iPhone. Sign up with phone number to start!

title: Free year of Hulu (US residents only)
body: US telecom promo: new customers in the United States get 12 months of Hulu free with eligible plans. Valid US billing address required.

title: EXPIRED: Free Domino's garlic bread coupon (ended last Friday)
body: This coupon for a free garlic bread with any pizza expired on Friday. Posting for archive purposes.

title: Free crypto masterclass + exclusive trading signals group
body: Join our free masterclass and get added to a premium signals WhatsApp group. Learn how our members make 20% monthly. Register with phone and PAN for verification.

title: Claim your free magazine subscription: 12 issues of Print Business Weekly
body: Free one-year print magazine subscription for professionals who register with full postal address and company details.

title: Free Rs 50 cashback on first recharge with NewPayApp
body: Download NewPayApp, create an account with KYC, add money and get Rs 50 cashback on your first mobile recharge. New users only.

title: Win free conference swag: retweet and tag 3 developer friends
body: Retweet our conference announcement and tag three friends for a chance to win a swag box with stickers and a cap. Winners drawn next month.

title: Free trial of premium antivirus — credit card required, auto-renews at Rs 4999/yr
body: 30-day free trial, card details mandatory at signup, converts automatically to a Rs 4999 annual plan unless cancelled by phone.

title: Free 6-month trial of unknown fitness app FitTrackr Pro (worth Rs 1800)
body: Startup FitTrackr offers its Pro tier free for 6 months. Requires creating a new account with email; no payment details. Brand launched last quarter.

title: Free specialty coffee sampler Rs 450 — but 25-minute signup survey
body: Blue Tokai-style roaster giving away a 100g sampler worth Rs 450 to coffee enthusiasts who complete a detailed 25-minute taste-profile survey and pay Rs 0 shipping.

title: Free Udemy course bundle (worth Rs 3000) — expires in 4 hours
body: Five highly-rated programming courses free with coupon codes for the next 4 hours only. Requires existing Udemy account, enrol each course separately.

title: Free 1-year cloud credits Rs 8000 from new Indian PaaS startup
body: Newly launched PaaS offering Rs 8000 in credits for a year to early adopters. Requires new account and GitHub linking; company is three months old.

title: Free movie tickets Tuesday: BookMyShow buy-1-get-1 for select banks
body: BOGO movie tickets every Tuesday for cardholders of several banks (list inside). Effective value ~Rs 300 per use; requires checking whether your card qualifies.

title: Free ebook bundle: 8 tech ebooks (Rs 2400) for newsletter signup
body: Publisher gives 8 DRM-free ebooks to new newsletter subscribers. Legit publisher, but adds you to a weekly marketing list; unsubscribe anytime.

title: Free premium VPN 12 months — from a lesser-known provider, needs new account
body: A small but reviewed VPN provider offers 12 months free (worth Rs 2500) to users who register with email. No card. Mixed independent reviews.

title: Free board game night kit Rs 900 — pickup only from one Bangalore store
body: Free starter kit for the first 200 people who show this post at the Koramangala store this weekend. Worth Rs 900 but requires a trip across town.

title: Free 3-month Audible trial (worth Rs 597) — needs card, cancels cleanly online
body: Audible India: 3 months free for Prime members, payment method required but cancellation is a documented two-click online flow. Auto-renews at Rs 199/mo if not cancelled.

title: Free mystery loot box Rs 500-2000 value from established gaming store, 15-min quiz
body: Established retailer gives a mystery gaming accessory (Rs 500-2000 value) to quiz participants; the quiz takes about 15 minutes and needs an account they already support via Google login.
